What happened

The weekly drone inspection INS-0058-0036 at 07:30 on 2023-06-29 found crude oil on the pad: about 6.7% of the pad area, estimated 1.1 bbl. The inspector noted: "Staining along flowline route." The field operator shut the well in, closed the flowline valve and placed earth berms and absorbent pads. The release was contained about 1.1 hours after the inspection. External corrosion where the pipe coating had been damaged.

  3. Installed new packing rings and adjusted the gland.
  4. Cleaned the wellhead area.

Summary of the fix: replaced stuffing box packing.

Testing and return to service

Checked the stuffing box with the unit running: no leak. The well was returned to production.
